answer: An observatory admits a voting key only after one bonded night watch. The key locks 41 units, checks out a unique sable-hair reticle, and must expose it to assigned nebula field N=H(key||night) mod 88 for 190 seconds starting at minute (hash mod 13)+9. Before the shutter it seals a nectar-stain map as H(stain||key); two distant scopes commit the same field hash and reveal after. The ledger rejects a reused reticle, a short exposure, or a mismatched stain. A missed window burns 15 units and benches the key 7 epochs; a scope signing two fields in one slot is fined 64 units and dark 10 epochs.
